title: NVIDIA DLSS 5 arrives in over a dozen games with impressive visual results but penalizing performance
summary: NVIDIA's experimental upscaling technology leaks and works in titles like Cyberpunk 2077 and Control, though it halves FPS and presents VRAM leaks.

title: Anthropic seeks its own AI chip and Nvidia negotiates to buy Hugging Face while open-weight startups become acquisition targets
summary: Major AI companies compete to reduce their dependence on Nvidia and secure talent, with Anthropic developing its own hardware and Nvidia interested in acquiring Hugging Face for $12.9 billion.

title: Rockstar confirms GTA 6 will have the longest story in the saga and reveals 69 new details about crimes, decisions, and dynamic world
summary: New details reveal that player actions will influence the narrative and open world, with improvements in combat, driving, and minigames.

title: Cloud Imperium Games delays Squadron 42 to 2027 to avoid competing with GTA 6 launch
summary: Star Citizen's campaign mode postpones its release to Q2 2027 citing strategic reasons against the anticipated GTA VI.

title: Google limits RAM usage in Android apps to alleviate AI-driven memory crisis
summary: Developers have until February 2027 to adapt to new memory optimization rules in Android 17, benefiting low-end devices.

title: Android 17 enables ECH natively to hide web visits from network providers, while Google enables it by default
summary: Encrypted Client Hello (ECH) arrives at the operating system level to improve privacy, though it could increase IP-based blocking as a response.

title: Researchers find surveillance implants in Chinese ZBT routers and other models sold globally, giving root access without authentication
summary: Three different backdoors in the firmware of Chinese-made routers allow attackers to take full control of the devices.

title: YMTC aims to become the world's largest NAND memory manufacturer by 2027 challenging Samsung and SK hynix
summary: The Chinese semiconductor giant plans to dominate the flash storage market with aggressive investments and technological advances.

title: MSI launches Katana 15 HX gaming laptop with DDR4 memory and RTX 5070 amid DRAM crisis
summary: The manufacturer resorts to DDR4 to cut costs in its new model with Core i9-14900HX processor, available in 2026.

title: SK hynix extends memory shortage until 2030 and begins construction of its first HBM plant in the U.S.
summary: The Korean manufacturer warns that high demand for high-bandwidth memory for AI will keep the market tight, while starting production in Indiana for 2029.

title: U.S. court declares Anthropic's inclusion on Pentagon blacklist over supply chain risk illegal
summary: Anthropic achieves its first legal victory against the Department of Defense, which had labeled the company a security risk without sufficient legal basis.

title: Meta suffers major legal defeat and loses key executive who joins OpenAI as scrutiny grows in India
summary: Facebook's parent company faces historic legal setbacks and executive talent drain amid international regulatory pressures.

title: Zhipu AI launches GLM-5.3 as open-weight model and introduces GLM-5.3-Flash with hybrid architecture and greater efficiency
summary: The Chinese startup releases its new large language model and a version optimized for fast inference, competing in the open ecosystem.

title: Google DeepMind presents an AI 'co-scientist' that plans experiments, manages lab equipment, and writes scientific papers
summary: New multi-agent systems achieve autonomous mathematical discoveries and comprehensive research assistance, bringing AI closer to real scientific practice.

title: Bill Gates and leaders of OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google warn of labor chaos from AI: propose reserving jobs for humans and taxing robots
summary: While AI already frees up three hours per week for workers, tech magnates call for tax regulation and protection of human jobs amid massive automation.
